title: Reinforcement learning designs amino quinoxaline RET inhibitors with nanomolar potency
summary: Single- and multi-objective reinforcement learning were compared for de novo design of RET inhibitors; 85% of multi-objective candidates met predicted potency, selectivity and phenotype thresholds. Selected novel amino quinoxaline derivatives showed IC50 of 0.78 nM for RET V804M, 142 nM for RET G810R and 0.53 nM for RET I788N. Compound counts and assay type are not stated in the abstract, and only potency was reported; this is a preprint.
ai_technology: Single- and multi-objective reinforcement learning de novo design filtered with SMPLIP-Score and ChargeNET affinity predictors and 23 off-target kinase and 108 phenotype classification models

evidence.tested: Experimental potency (IC50) of selected compounds against three RET variants.
